finish: Restrained enamel gradients, cool bevelled rims and selective short highlights; original one-concept silhouettes retained.
artDirection: One concept per sticker; consistent bold shapes; opaque colours; dark contour and cool rim for both themes. No text paragraphs, scenes, grain, paper backing or glow. Native SVG for all display sizes.
